---
title: "Sorting and taking"
---

{{< include ../_setup.qmd >}}

`sort` orders the rows, and `descending` reverses one key.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### R

```{r}
sales |> sort(descending(revenue)) |> take(3)
```

### Python

```{python}
sales >> sort(descending(col.revenue)) >> take(3)
```

:::

There is no `ascending`, because ascending is what happens when you do not ask
for anything, and a word meaning "do the default" is a second way to say the
same thing. Sorting by several keys reads left to right.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### R

```{r}
sales |> sort(product, descending(revenue))
```

### Python

```{python}
sales >> sort(col.product, descending(col.revenue))
```

:::
